units.source_text: 忽地，黎明前的悲伤涌上心头……

en.t: Suddenly, the sadness before dawn welled up in my heart...
Of course, it is good to lick each other's wounds.

units.source_text: 可是这样互相舔对方永远不会痊愈的伤口，最后，恐怕连舌头都要舔破了。

en.t: But if we keep licking each other's wounds that will never heal, in the end I am afraid even our tongues will be worn raw.
